pages.title: Electroplating Bath
pages.text: A bath of metal salt and a current through it: the metal leaves the solution and coats whatever hangs from the cathode.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the current density and the plating time. Faraday: the coat grows as current × time; it must end up 20 to 50 µm thick. Above 8 A/dm² the coat burns. Shorter runs are faster.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Nickel-Plated Iron, Telescope Mirror Blank.
